guitar.notes: Louis Bertignac is well known for the Gibson SG in Téléphone; keeping medium since the entry already correctly captures the variety used.

tone.target: bright chorus-clean with light crunch and delay
tone.profile: bright chorus-clean with light crunch and delay
tone.summary: A shimmering, stereo chorus effect feeding into a clean pre-amp (Comp/Boost) for light crunch, followed by an AC30 or US Deluxe model, paired with a 2x12 cab, finished with digital delay and room reverb.

rig.name: Telephone - Prends ce que tu veux - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Smooth dynamics and add initial warmth for the clean tone.
Create the required shimmering, stereo chorus effect.
Provide the specified light crunch and edge-of-breakup without heavy distortion.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is a general overdrive, but its low drive setting allows for the required 'light crunch' feel.

blocks.purpose: Simulate a clean, bright American tone suitable for chorus and delay.
Provide a bright, focused cabinet sound matching the clean US Deluxe amp.
Enhance the bright top end and clarity as requested.
Add spaciousness and the required delay repeats.
Add subtle ambience and depth to the overall clean sound.

improvements.summary: Enhance cabinet realism and brightness to match the shimmering chorus tone.

proposals.reason: Improve high-end clarity for bright, chorused clean tones.
